content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate I: Any graduate with MPH. Desirable: Prior experience in research projects, especially in documentation along with field experience. Field Investigator: Any graduate with MSW. Desirable: Prior experience in projects, especially in the field settings.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Associate I: Rs 31000 + 18% HRA (Rs. 36,580/-) Per Month Field Investigator: Rs 19000 + 18% HRA (Rs. 22,420/-) Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Project Associate-I and 1 post for Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Project Associate-I is any graduate with MPH. Prior experience in research projects is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Field Investigator is any graduate with MSW. Prior experience in field settings is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both posts is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-I is Rs 31000 + 18% HRA (Rs. 36,580/-) per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The salary for Field Investigator is Rs 19000 + 18% HRA (Rs. 22,420/-) per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Written Test (if needed) followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. How should I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: You need to apply via email by sending your complete bio-data and self-attested copies of required documents to the official email address before the last date.
